Generated by `data-models/dtd-xml-sql/build.py` from `wikibase-model.json` and the CSV templates. Do not edit by hand.

## Conceptual model

The classes of the Wikibase model and how the CSV files connect them. `EXHIBITION_ITEM` and `SCAN_LOCATION` are CSV files that become statements with qualifiers in Wikibase (`Exhibited at` and `Appears in catalogue`). The inverse link `Exhibition catalogue` is created from `catalogue_of` and is not drawn.

## SQLite schema (Entity-Attribute-Value)

Read directly from `linked-open-exhibition.sqlite`. The model tables describe the attributes. The data tables hold every fact as one row in `statement`. Triggers reject statements whose property is not allowed on the entity's class, whose value has the wrong kind, or whose target has the wrong class.

```{mermaid}
erDiagram
    entity_class ||--o{ property_class : "class_key"
    property ||--o{ property_class : "property_key"
    entity_class ||--o{ property_range : "class_key"
    property ||--o{ property_range : "property_key"
    property ||--o{ qualifier_of : "property_key"
    property ||--o{ qualifier_of : "qualifier_key"
    entity_class ||--o{ entity : "class_key"
    entity ||--o{ label : "entity_id"
    entity o|--o{ statement : "value_entity_id"
    property ||--o{ statement : "property_key"
    entity ||--o{ statement : "entity_id"
    property ||--o{ qualifier : "property_key"
    statement ||--o{ qualifier : "statement_id"

    meta {
        TEXT key PK
        TEXT value
    }
    entity_class {
        TEXT class_key PK
        TEXT label_en
        TEXT label_de
        TEXT description_en
        TEXT wikidata
        TEXT cidoc
        TEXT linked_art
        TEXT lido
    }
    property {
        TEXT property_key PK
        TEXT label_en
        TEXT label_de
        TEXT description_en
        TEXT datatype
        INTEGER is_qualifier
        TEXT wikidata
        TEXT cidoc
        TEXT linked_art
        TEXT lido
    }
    property_class {
        TEXT property_key PK, FK
        TEXT class_key PK, FK
    }
    property_range {
        TEXT property_key PK, FK
        TEXT class_key PK, FK
    }
    qualifier_of {
        TEXT qualifier_key PK, FK
        TEXT property_key PK, FK
    }
    entity {
        TEXT entity_id PK
        TEXT class_key FK
        TEXT wikibase_id
        TEXT source
    }
    label {
        TEXT entity_id PK, FK
        TEXT lang PK
        TEXT label
    }
    statement {
        INTEGER statement_id PK
        TEXT entity_id FK
        TEXT property_key FK
        TEXT value_text
        TEXT value_entity_id FK
        TEXT lang
        TEXT unit
        INTEGER position
    }
    qualifier {
        INTEGER qualifier_id PK
        INTEGER statement_id FK
        TEXT property_key FK
        TEXT value_text
    }
```

## Example queries

```sql
-- artworks with their creator, date, materials and catalogue
SELECT * FROM v_artwork LIMIT 10;

-- every statement about one artwork
SELECT property_label, value, lang, unit FROM v_statement WHERE entity_id = 'ART001';

-- artworks that are not linked to a catalogue
SELECT entity_id, entity_label FROM v_entity e
 WHERE class_key = 'artwork'
   AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM statement s WHERE s.entity_id = e.entity_id
                    AND s.property_key = 'appears_in_catalogue');

-- how much of each property is filled in
SELECT p.label_en, COUNT(*) AS statements
  FROM statement s JOIN property p USING (property_key)
 GROUP BY p.label_en ORDER BY statements DESC;
```
